old_problem: Truncated NVLink counter snapshots are not a bandwidth measurement and cannot prove all required links/directions. Traffic shape, sample window, raw byte/time semantics, per-link and aggregate thresholds, thermal/power limits and recovery were unbound.
disposition_reason: The row clearly defines NVLink bandwidth through NVQual Test #9. Workload direction/payload/concurrency, graph, sample duration/repetitions, raw measurement formula and signed thresholds are Project Configuration. ED-15 forbids PASS without them, but allows a complete parameterized testcase whose execution gate remains closed until they are supplied.
decision_basis: XLSX row 2136, same-row DeepSeek columns, GPT V2, historical record, unique identity and ED-01 through ED-30 were reviewed; actual next formal row Functionality 2137 / Wistron-HGX NV PVP HW-00014-V002 / 89d690a550dd2a7b was directly read from XLSX and manifest.
Bind the licensed pinned Test #9 stack, stable GPU/link graph and every required traffic direction before load.
Pin payload/buffer, concurrency, warmup, measurement duration, repetitions, raw counter or byte/time semantics, aggregation, units and per-link/aggregate thresholds/tolerance.
Use trusted authenticated access and retain complete untruncated raw samples; reject sshpass, host-key bypass, head/grep truncation and vendor PASS without auditable measurements.
Run on an otherwise idle SUT with synchronized topology, error, utilization, temperature and power evidence; preserve logs and do not reset links to force a pass.
Stop on first shortfall, missing/degraded link, topology change, thermal/power limit, GPU/fabric/host fault or evidence gap; cool down via the signed plan and never retry automatically.
No NVQual/load, nvidia-smi, SSH, log clearing, link reset, cooldown/recovery, retry or DUT operation was performed.

test_case.test_name: Reproducible per-link HGX NVQual Test #9 NVLink bandwidth
test_case.purpose: Measure every required HGX NVLink traffic direction with the approved Test #9 workload and prove per-link and aggregate bandwidth meet signed thresholds without topology degradation, errors, unsafe thermal/power behavior, hang or reboot.
required_package: Licensed pinned NVIDIA NVQual Test #9 bandwidth configuration and compatible stack
Signed GPU UUID/serial/slot and per-link port/topology map
Approved direction, payload/buffer, concurrency, warmup, sample duration and repetition profile
Signed raw counter/byte-time formula, units, aggregation and per-link/aggregate thresholds/tolerance
Reserved idle HGX SUT, trusted access, synchronized telemetry, abort/cooldown and recovery plan
test_case.test_command: BLOCKED until Project Configuration and thresholds are signed. Preserve/hash baseline logs, topology, counters and health. On an idle SUT run only the pinned Test #9 workload/directions. Retain complete raw per-link counter or byte/time samples, calculate bandwidth with the approved formula, and correlate topology, errors, utilization, temperature and power. Stop on first limit or anomaly; do not co-run workloads, reset links, extend load or retry.
test_case.expected_result: Every signed direction/link has complete valid raw measurements and meets its approved bandwidth threshold/tolerance; aggregate results meet their separately approved limits; topology and all GPUs remain healthy, thermal/power limits are respected, and no hang, reboot or disqualifying error occurs.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: No PASS without signed workload, graph, measurement semantics and thresholds. PASS requires every complete per-link and aggregate comparison plus clean synchronized health evidence. FAIL on any threshold miss, missing/invalid sample, link/topology degradation, error, thermal/power breach, hang/reboot or failed recovery. Missing parameters/artifacts are BLOCKED; a vendor pass line or counter snapshot is insufficient.
safety_gate: Gate CLOSED until workload, graph, measurement/threshold contract, thermal/power aborts and cooldown/recovery are signed.
Reserve an idle non-production SUT with stable cooling/power and trusted authenticated access.
Preserve baseline evidence and monitor independent thermal/power/fabric health throughout the heavy load.
Stop and cool down without link reset, load extension or automatic retry on first anomaly.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant/hash, owner-approved Test #9 bandwidth manifest/version and authorization
Stable GPU/link graph and signed direction/payload/concurrency/warmup/sample/repetition contract
Complete raw pre/during/post per-link counters or byte/time samples, formulas, calculated distributions and threshold comparisons
NVQual output, topology, utilization, fabric/GPU/link errors, thermal/power and timestamps
Kernel/BMC/SEL evidence, baseline hashes, abort/cooldown or clean final state, no-retry audit and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: On threshold miss, link/topology change, thermal/power limit, GPU/fabric/host fault or evidence gap, terminate the approved workload, preserve first-fault artifacts and follow signed cooldown/isolation. Do not reset links or rerun automatically; quarantine if expected fabric and health do not recover.
